pnp:SiteGroup.Title: {groupsitename} Members
pnp:SiteGroup.Description: Use this group to grant people contribute permissions to the SharePoint site: GROUP0Template20260604

pnp:SiteGroup.Title: {groupsitename} Owners
pnp:SiteGroup.Description: Use this group to grant people full control permissions to the SharePoint site: GROUP0Template20260604

pnp:SiteGroup.Title: {groupsitename} Visitors
pnp:SiteGroup.Description: Use this group to grant people read permissions to the SharePoint site: GROUP0Template20260604

pnp:ContentType.Name: Content Freshness
pnp:ContentType.Description: Used to create a dynamic page related to contentfreshness.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Composed Looks
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Use this list to store composed looks. These looks can be applied to this site by navigating to Site Settings and choosing Change the look.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Converted Forms
pnp:ListInstance.Description: List of user browser-enabled form templates on this site collection.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Form Templates
pnp:ListInstance.Description: This library contains administrator-approved form templates that were activated to this site collection.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: List Template Gallery
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Make a template available for use in list creation by adding it to this gallery. The templates in this gallery are available to this site and all sites under it. Default list templates are not shown.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Master Page Gallery
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Use the master page gallery to store master pages. The master pages in this gallery are available to this site and any sites underneath it.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Site Assets
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Use this library to store files which are included on pages within this site, such as images on Wiki pages.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Solution Gallery
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Use the Solution Gallery to track user solutions.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Style Library
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Use the style library to store style sheets, such as CSS or XSL files. The style sheets in this gallery can be used by this site or any of its subsites.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: TaxonomyHiddenList
pnp:ListInstance.Description: The description for the hidden list for the taxonomy feature.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Theme Gallery
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Use the theme gallery to store themes. The themes in this gallery can be used by this site or any of its subsites.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Web Part Gallery
pnp:ListInstance.Description: Use this Web Part Gallery to store and retrieve Web Parts. The Web Parts in this gallery are available to this site and all sites under it. To preview a Web Part, click its title.

Field.Name: QuickAddGroups
Field.Description: Please specify site template names separated by ";#". Your web part will appear in "Recommended Items" category when a user tries to add a web part to any web part pages within sites using site templates mentioned here. Otherwise, for page level recommendations of web parts, you can include a tag in here and then add that same tag to "Recommended" property on the web part adder control on the page in question.

pnp:ListInstance.Title: Web Template Extensions
pnp:ListInstance.Description: This list stores run results for the Web Template Extensions feature.
